needs.title: Oakridge Elementary HVAC replacement
needs.summary: Replace aging HVAC equipment. The project is named in the proposed $80M school bond (Nov 3, 2026) as part of a broader Oakridge Refresh (HVAC, roofing, flooring, painting).
needs.why_track: A whole-system HVAC replacement is a capital project: the School Board lists it in the 10-year CIP and funds it through County bonds, so it waits for the bond cycle. We found no dollar cutoff in any APS document that would move it to the faster maintenance (MC/MM) budget.
